states.imagePrompt:
Use case: identity-preserving character pose exploration. This is one finished still-image concept for human approval, NOT an animation atlas, rig, UI mockup or implementation.
Use the supplied blue Fold character as the exact identity reference. Preserve its softly rounded pillow-square body, distinctive thick folded upper-right corner, subtle three-quarter frontal view, periwinkle-blue hue, soft matte clay surface, big warm ivory oval eyes with glossy dark pupils and tiny friendly mouth. Keep the same body proportions and facial character. Do not redesign it as a human, robot, animal, or a different mascot.
Render the entire character in one coherent, beautifully sculpted 3D pose with physically believable soft lighting from upper-left. If the gesture needs arms, give it SHORT, softly rounded blue toy arms that grow naturally from the sides of its body, with an elbow bend, a small wrist and a clearly readable little palm, rounded fingers and thumb. Hands must be in the same blue clay material and proportionate to this small mascot. The geometry, perspective, contact shadow and overlap must all belong to one unified model. Avoid floating hands, pasted-on limbs, detached joints, skeletal fingers, muscular human arms, veins, skin, gloves, claws, long noodles, extra fingers or swollen blob-like hands. Keep the silhouette simple and charming at avatar size.
Composition: one character centered on a plain very pale cool gray background matching the reference, square 1024x1024 canvas, character body about 62 percent of canvas height with generous room for hands on both sides. Preserve the reference's camera angle and approximate eye placement, except the expression and head tilt required for this state. No neck, torso extension, legs, feet, desk or ground plane; the rounded square itself is the whole character. No props, text, labels, symbols, emoji, panels, borders, watermark or additional characters.
The state below is the ONLY intended change to identity. Make the pose natural, restrained, cute, and immediately understandable.

STATE: NEUTRAL / IDLE. Faithfully recreate the supplied reference at higher resolution: relaxed forward gaze, gentle little smile, body upright. No visible arms are needed. This is the identity anchor for the set; stay especially faithful to the original face, fold and blue material.
